## Even better?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
n_family <- n_docs*p_family_practice
n_non_family <- n_docs*(1 - p_family_practice)
n_docs_specialty <- c(n_family, n_non_family)
years <- rep(year, 2)
specialty <- rep(c("Family Practice", "Non-Family Practice"), each = length(year))

docs_df_new <- data.frame(years, specialty, n_docs = n_docs_specialty)
```
:::


---


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
docs_df_new |>
  mutate(years = factor(years)) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = years, y = n_docs, fill = specialty) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ylab("Doctors") +
  xlab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Doctors in California by speciality 1964-1990.](include/fig/fig-docs-by-specialty-1.png){#fig-docs-by-specialty width=672}
:::
:::


## Another alternative


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
total_pop <- n_docs*ratio_to_pop
pop <- c(total_pop, n_docs)
docs_general <- rep(c("Non-doctors", "Doctors"), each = 3)

docs_df_another <- data.frame(years, docs_general, pop)
```
:::


---


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
docs_df_another |>
  mutate(years = factor(years)) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = years, y = pop, fill = docs_general) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  ylab("Population") +
  xlab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Doctors vs. non-doctors in California as a fraction of the total population 1964-1990.](include/fig/fig-docs-as-p-population-1.png){#fig-docs-as-p-population width=672}
:::
:::
